statement: Whenever index_pairs returns a result r, call an ordered pair (i,j) a matching pair when 0 <= i <= j < len(text) and there exists k with 0 <= k < len(words) such that j - i + 1 = len(words[k]) and text[i+t] = words[k][t] for every t with 0 <= t < j - i + 1. Then r is exactly the vector of all matching pairs, each written as the two-element vector [i,j], with every matching pair appearing exactly once and no other entries, in strictly increasing order by first coordinate and then by second coordinate: for every a < b in r, writing r[a]=[i,j] and r[b]=[i',j'], either i < i', or i = i' and j < j'.
preconditions: The inputs satisfy the LeetCode constraints: 1 <= len(text) <= 100; 1 <= len(words) <= 20; for every k with 0 <= k < len(words), 1 <= len(words[k]) <= 50; every byte of text and of every words[k] is an ASCII lowercase letter from 'a' to 'z'; and the word vectors words[0],...,words[len(words)-1] are pairwise distinct.
